tagline: ProbPath is an AI-powered probability tree generator designed to make probability problems easier to visualize and solve
description: ProbPath is an AI-powered probability tree generator designed to make probability problems easier to visualize and solve. Simply describe a scenario in natural language, and ProbPath generates a complete probability tree with branches, labels, and calculated path probabilities. Users can refine the tree through chat, edit nodes and probabilities directly, and automatically validate that branch probabilities are consistent.
